milestones.label: Approval (stamp)
milestones.detail: Stamp Approval of National Grid’s proposed tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 1403. By Chairman O'Connor, Commissioners Hayden and Fraser. The Department has approved National Grid’s proposed tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 1403. The Department will investigate the proposed refund of excess ADIT associated with the tax credit provision in the Company’s annual retail rate filing (i.e., D.P.U. 19-05) and the excess ADIT associated with reconciling mechanisms in the individual dockets for those mechanisms. Further, in D.P.U. 18-150, the Department will investigate the Company’s proposal to remove the amortization of excess ADIT associated with any reconciling mechanism from that mechanism and credit the remaining amounts through base rates effective November 1, 2019.
